verdict_reason: New per-unit animal-identifier model omits identificationDetails and description, two fields the ticket's own AC requires, so the AC is only partially met.

todos.issue: AnimalIdentifier is missing identificationDetails and description — the ticket's AC lists 5 per-unit fields (tattoo, horse name, identification details, description, permanent address) but only 3 of those plus microchip/earTag/passport/tattoo/horseName/permanentAddress are modelled; identificationDetails and description have no slot at all, so those two fields will silently drop just like before the fix
todos.fix: Add 'private String identificationDetails;' and 'private String description;' to AnimalIdentifier, and wire them through NotificationService/NotificationCopyMapper and the frontend mapper alongside the other per-unit fields
